Product information:
Product Name: PERIPERA Ink Jellable Tint

Product Color to choose
#01 Be Apricot
#02 Pink Difference
#03 Probably Rose
#04 Dance With Warm
#05 Cool Luck Cool Luck

Product Weight: 3.7g

What inside the box: 1x Ink Jellable Tint

Product Content
Wearable color shade that adheres to the original color and creates a stylish color feel. No more staining that only remains as pink. The first application is moisturizing, comfortable, close-fitting, water-gel formula. The finishing touch is a comfortable Mongle Water Gel without worrying about smudging. Gelable glutinous rice cake tip for easy volume control. Easy to control amount of pigmentation, the tip applies evenly and adheres tightly without streaking.

Direction
Take an appropriate amount of the contents and apply it from the inside of the lips to naturally fill them in.

Caution
For external use only. Discontinue use immediately if rash, irritation, or discomfort develops and consult your physician. Do not apply to broken, irritation, or itching skin. Keep out of reach of children. Do not store at temperature too high or too low and in direct sunlight.
